soldier: Head brownish yellow, paler than in the large form, nasus becoming gradually darker from the base forwards and pale reddish brown, antennae slightly paler than the head, the anterior margin of the pronotum darker than the head, the remainder deep yellow, legs yellow. Head almost bare, otherwise as in the large soldier. Head nearly circular, the posterior margin rather flat, wider than long; in lateral view the nasus slightly turned up, the base of the nasus more strongly raised, the convexity of the vertex less than in the large form, nasus tubular, the apical teeth of the mandibles indistinct. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 longest.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.
